Offscreen rendering has no display surface, capture, or physical input-to-display measurement.
Authority mode reports simulated duration and in-process authenticated command dispatch; network modes use actual wall time, TLS workers, and durable storage.
GPU timestamp observations exclude display and final pending slots; bounded omissions are retained.

limits: Delay applies to each TCP read chunk, not decrypted game messages.
